gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.legend: White: you. Brass: drones. Red: enemies. Numbers: patrol marks. Only land the suit has seen is drawn.
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.studied.none: Nothing studied yet. Read a creature with the Scrying Lens, or fell five of a kind, and the table remembers it here.
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.section.dutie: Duties when there is nothing to fight
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.tip.hint: Point at an order to read what it does.
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.tip.deploy: Drones leave the Core and fly with you: one for each level of the Mind, up to five. Costs charge. A blow to a drone is partly felt by you.
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.tip.stow.name: Stow the drones
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.tip.stow: The drones return to the Core and dock. Anything they were carrying is set down.
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.tip.shell: The drones circle you close and take the blows meant for you, a drone to each blow, and fall out for a while. Press again to send them out to fight.
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.tip.missile: One free drone streaks at the creature you have locked, or are looking at, and bursts on it. It is back after a while.
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.tip.form_clos: The drones swarm tight round the nearest enemy and strike often, lightly.
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.tip.form_surr: The drones ring the enemy and dive in turns, hard.
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.tip.form_stra: The drones fly passes along the line between you and the enemy, cutting across it.
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.tip.form_scou: The drones fly ahead in a line and outline every creature they see, for you to follow.
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.tip.fetch: With nothing to fight, a drone takes up an item that has lain a while and carries it back to you. Items you only just dropped are left alone.
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.tip.mend.name: Mend
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.tip.mend: Each drone near you slowly mends your hurts.
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.tip.patrol: With nothing to fight, the drones walk the route you marked: look at a spot, pick Mark Route in the Rig menu, and J marks again. Up to four marks; a fifth replaces the oldest.
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.tip.kind.name: Decoy kind
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.tip.kind: Lure: one false image stands ahead and every enemy turns on it while you go unseen. Trio: three images copy your every move and strike again for a fifth of your damage.
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.tip.decoy: Costs charge and needs a few moments before it can be cast again. A blow to an image pops it.
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.tip.bank.name: Bank shot
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.tip.bank: While on, look at a wall with an enemy near it: a faint line shows the bounce. Arrows, thrown things and the palm blast that strike that wall turn off it into the enemy, and on to one more.
gui.jaymospowers.rig_table.tip.field: Raise rings of light that keep the blows you parry, three at most, a perfect parry at double strength. Use it again to let them all go at once as a blast as strong as what was kept.
message.jaymospowers.rig_picks.needs_cor: The Mind needs the Core to wake it.
message.jaymospowers.rig_picks.drone.non: No drone is free to send.
message.jaymospowers.rig_picks.drone.she: Drones close round you as a shell.
message.jaymospowers.rig_picks.field.rel: The field lets go of %1$s blows at once.
message.jaymospowers.rig_picks.field.ven: The field runs out and lets go of %1$s blows.
message.jaymospowers.rig_picks.decoy.lur: A false image wakes, and you go unseen.
message.jaymospowers.rig_picks.decoy.tri: Three false images take your stance.
message.jaymospowers.rig_picks.decoy.kin: Decoy: one image that draws every enemy.
Decoy: three images that copy you.
